title: Charmed Tower: 3D rogue-like where all character meshes, textures, and rigs are AI generated
author: whistling_frank

comments.author: whistling_frank
comments.body:
This is a web-based game with procgen dungeons that are populated by characters that were generated in our app. An account is required to play, but playing the game is free. This is a demo that we built to show off the fact that that generated assets can be immediately interactive.

You can create your own character and start running around this game in a few minutes.

comments.author: cdcox
comments.body:
Really cool demo, I picked a chicken who the game failed to properly PBR cover and the rigging still worked really good. 

I'm really impressed by the tech stack here being able to slap out that many meshes is pretty impressive. And it's a pretty fun little demo that shows it off well. I only saw a couple of the really dynamic animations which was kind of a bummer because I thought that was one of the cooler features, you might intentionally push weirder models to show that off. Like I saw some fish guy who 'waddled' correctly and that was neat. Also some obvious gaps around neutrals and turns for the animation (the characters kind of roomba when doing standing turns). But this whole product feels really good and that's  such a fun way to show it off.

replies.author: whistling_frank
replies.body: I’m glad you enjoyed it, and thank you for the detailed feedback- it’s much appreciated. Your point about the turns is well taken. One of the benefits of building a demo like this is that it helps us find these gaps first hand.
